# Weekly Market Briefing — July 5, 2026

## 1. Market Regime — Cautiously Risk-On, Rate-Constrained
The backdrop is a **normal, growth-consistent regime**: the yield curve is upward-sloping at **+0.82 pts (10Y 4.49%, 3M 3.67%)**, with **VIX at 16.15** signaling a calm volatility regime. The **dollar firmed to 100.86 (▲0.79 MoM)**, a modest headwind for commodities and non-US assets. Broad-market factor readings lean **risk-on**: cyclical small caps (IWM Momentum **87**, Value **78**) and broad indices (VTI Momentum **76**, SPY **73**) rank strongly, though defensives still carry high Low-Vol scores (DIA **73**, VOO **69**). This is a **higher-for-longer rate environment**, not an easing one — the Fed held the federal funds rate steady at 3.50%–3.75% at Chair Kevin Warsh's first meeting, noting activity is expanding at a solid pace while inflation remains elevated.

## 2. This Week's News
The dominant story was a **soft June jobs report**. The economy added 57,000 jobs in June, compared with the 113,000 expected, while the unemployment rate came in at 4.2% versus the 4.3% forecast. The cooler reading broke a three-month hot streak, supporting the case for the Fed to hold rates steady for now. Market reaction diverged: the Dow rose more than 1.1% toward a new record, while the S&P 500 was little changed and the tech-heavy Nasdaq fell 0.8%; Tesla dropped 7% despite beating Q2 delivery estimates. Semiconductors extended losses as a sell-off in South Korean chipmakers drove a 7.9% plunge in the Kospi, with AMD, Micron, and Intel continuing to get hit. The softer data pressured the dollar and sent gold surging. This week is quiet, with FOMC meeting minutes due Wednesday, July 8, as Wall Street looks for hints on the Fed's rate plans.

## 3. Factor Leadership — Momentum Rewarded, Concentrated in Tech
**Momentum** remains the dominant factor, led by **XLK (96)** among sectors and reflected in mega-cap winners. The standout is the June payroll miss not yet denting trend leaders: GOOGL (Momentum **94**, 12-1Mom **+101%**), AMD (Momentum **100**, 12-1Mom **+292%**), and SNOW (**98**). **Value** leadership sits in rate-sensitive defensives and energy: TLT (**100**), XLC (**96**), CVX (**89**), XLE (**87**). Crypto is the clear laggard across every momentum reading (BTC **20**, ETH **13**, ADA **2**).

## 5. Themes to Watch
- **FOMC minutes (Wed):** clues on hike-vs-hold split; the June dot plot showed 9 of 18 participants anticipated at least one hike before year-end on inflation concerns.
- **Tech/semis fragility:** watch whether the AI-chip rotation deepens or stabilizes.
